name: Small multiples
desc: Repeat one identical chart per group on shared axes so the eye compares shapes, not legends.

name: Choropleth map
desc: Color geographic areas by a value to show spatial pattern.

name: Flow/Sankey budget
desc: Bands whose width equals quantity show how a total splits across stages, making losses visible as thinning bands (Minard).

name: Slope chart
desc: Connect each category's value in two states with a line so rank swaps and direction pop out.

name: Receipt/waterfall decomposition
desc: Break a total into additive line items so the reader sees which component drives the total.

name: Direct standardization counterfactual
desc: Re-weight region B's outcomes to region A's mix (station type, temperature) to separate composition from true performance, as epidemiologists age-adjust rates.

name: Simpson reversal reveal
desc: Show aggregate comparison then stratified one where the ranking flips, exposing a confounder.

name: Radial 24h clock
desc: Polar chart with hour as angle shows daily rhythm and peak windows at a glance.

name: Color stripes
desc: One colored band per unit (day/session) encoding value with no axes, so long patterns read instantly (warming stripes).

name: Vital-sign monitor
desc: Time trace drawn against a shaded normal band with alarm markers where it leaves the band, as in ICU monitors.

name: Nutrition-label panel
desc: Fixed-format standardized panel of the same metrics per item so any two items compare line by line.

name: Transit-map schematic
desc: Abstract topology over true geography to show sequence and connections clearly.

name: Isotype unit chart
desc: One icon equals N events so counts and rates become countable objects (Neurath).

name: Dose-response curve
desc: Plot outcome against exposure level with fitted curve and band to show threshold and slope.

name: Forest plot
desc: Effect estimates with confidence intervals per subgroup aligned to a no-effect line, showing which differences are real.

name: Pareto trade-off front
desc: Scatter two costs (price vs time) and draw the frontier of non-dominated options.

name: Journey map emotion curve
desc: Stages of an experience on x, emotional state on y, with pain points annotated.

name: Natural-frequency risk phrasing
desc: State risk as 1 in N counts rather than percents, which people grasp more accurately (Gigerenzer).

name: Ridgeline distributions
desc: Stacked density curves per group expose spread and bimodality hidden by means.

name: KPI dashboard tiles
desc: Grid of headline numbers per group.

name: Ranked bar chart
desc: Sorted bars per group.
